summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style entry on Barangay Pulo, one of the eighteen urbanized barangays of Cabuyao city in Laguna province, Philippines. It describes the barangay's location about 3 kilometers from Cabuyao's city proper along the national highway. It also gives population figures from the 2010 Census and its rank among Cabuyao's barangays.
one_line: Barangay Pulo is one of eighteen urbanized barangays in Cabuyao, Laguna, Philippines, with about 15,124 residents in 2010.
key_facts: Barangay Pulo has the PSGC code 043404013.
Barangay Pulo is one of the eighteen (18) urbanized barangays comprising the city of Cabuyao.
Cabuyao is located in the province of Laguna, Philippines.
Barangay Pulo lies about 3 kilometers away from the city proper of Cabuyao.
Barangay Pulo is situated along the national highway.
According to the 2010 Census, Barangay Pulo has a population of 15,124 inhabitants.
Barangay Pulo's population grew from 13,193 in Census 2007.
Barangay Pulo is ranked as the 6th largest barangay in Cabuyao by population.
